eye_arts.name: Hawk Eye
eye_arts.blurb: You see targets from far off, and your techniques curve to meet them. Natures show who is weak to you.

eye_arts.name: Mirror Eye
eye_arts.blurb: A dash that slips through a blow slows the world for a heartbeat and steadies your chakra.

eye_arts.name: Seal Eye
eye_arts.blurb: You read hands as they move. Rivals' seals come slower, and your own fly faster.

eye_arts.name: Still Eye
eye_arts.blurb: A guard raised at the very last instant turns a blow aside completely, and pays you back in chakra.
